title: 2027 Busch Gardens Concert Series
summary: Busch Gardens TAKES CENTER STAGE for 2027 with the Biggest Concert Lineup in Its History: More Than 30 Live, FULL-LENGTH Shows
body_markdown:
**TAMPA, Fla. & WILLIAMSBURG, Va. (Nov. 19, 2026)** – In 2027, Busch Gardens parks’ live concert series reaches new heights with more than 30 full-length performances across Tampa Bay and Williamsburg, the strongest and most diverse lineup in the series history. Every concert is included with park admission, so guests can pair a night of live music with a full day of thrill rides, animal encounters and food festivals. For fans who want to catch every show, an Annual Pass or Membership is the best way to do it, opening the door to the full 2027 concert lineup.


Anchored by the Food & Wine Music Festival in Tampa Bay, and the fan-favorite Food & Wine Festival in Williamsburg, the 2027 lineup is the strongest in series history and features high-energy genres, including country, pop, hip-hop, R&B, rap, classic rock, 80’s rock, 90’s rock, alternative, hard rock, Christian, and Latin. The acts include Flo Rida, Boyz II Men, Chris Young, Skillet, Soulja Boy, Trace Adkins, Air Supply, JoJo Siwa, Flyleaf, Jesse McCartney, Ginuwine, Sugar Ray, Better Than Ezra, Vertical Horizon, Relient K and Taking Back Sunday.


Guests can expect:


- Full-length live concerts, 60+ minutes, included with all forms of park admission
- Live music performances paired with a full-day park experience featuring food festivals, attractions, and animal encounters
- Premium reserved concert access options
- The flexibility to attend multiple concerts throughout the season with an Annual Pass or Membership
- Limited-time Black Friday savings on tickets, Passes and Memberships, save up to 60% off


“Our concert series has grown into something our guests look forward to year after year,” said Marc Swanson, Chief Executive Officer of United Parks & Resorts. “With more than 30 concerts, the 2027 lineup spans multiple genres and decades, giving visitors even more reasons to experience one of our Busch Gardens parks.”


## Busch Gardens Tampa Bay


The enhanced Food & Wine Music Festival pairs culinary offerings with live entertainment. Country singer Trace Adkins kicks off the festival on Feb. 20, with concerts continuing every weekend* of the event through May 23. The full lineup includes:


### Food, Wine & Music Festival


- Saturday, Feb. 20: Trace Adkins
- Sunday, Feb. 21: JET
- Saturday, Feb. 27: Toad The Wet Sprocket and Vertical Horizon
- Sunday, Feb. 28: The Red Jumpsuit Apparatus
- Saturday, March 6: Soulja Boy
- Sunday, March 7: Switchfoot
- Saturday, March 13: Scotty McCreery
- Sunday, March 14: Grupo Mania
- Saturday, March 20: Loud Luxury
- Sunday, March 21: Shontelle
- Saturday, March 27: Dev
- Saturday, April 3: Flo Rida
- Sunday, April 4: Ying Yang Twins
- Saturday, April 10: Boyz II Men
- Sunday, April 11: Artist to be announced
- Saturday, April 17: Skillet
- Sunday, April 18: Elvis Crespo
- Saturday, April 24: Warrant, Great White and White Lion
- Sunday, April 25: JoJo Siwa
- Saturday, May 1: Chris Young
- Sunday, May 2: Alien Ant Farm and Finger Eleven
- Saturday, May 8: Air Supply
- Saturday, May 15: Jesse McCartney
- Sunday, May 16: Ginuwine
- Saturday, May 22: Tasha Cobbs Leonard
- Sunday, May 23: Flyleaf


**No concerts on Easter Sunday or Mother’s Day.*


## Busch Gardens Williamsburg


Busch Gardens Williamsburg heats up in 2027 with the start of its live concert series during the fan-favorite Food & Wine Festival. Beginning in May, the park will feature chart-topping musicians across multiple genres, including 90’s rock, alternative rock, Christian and hip-hop.


The full concert lineup includes:


- Saturday, May 8: Better Than Ezra and Vertical Horizon
- Saturday, June 5: Skillet
- Saturday, June 12: Sugar Ray
- Saturday, Aug. 21: Soulja Boy and Ying Yang Twins
- Saturday, Aug. 28: Relient K
- Saturday, Sept. 4: Taking Back Sunday


## Best Way to Experience Concerts at Busch Gardens


The Busch Gardens Annual Pass and Memberships programs are designed to give guests flexibility with four tiers, each one allowing guests to choose the benefits that best fit their lifestyle. During the limited time Black Friday sale, Annual Passes and Memberships are up to 60% off.


From unlimited visits and seasonal event access to exclusive freebies and savings, Pass Members can expect:


- FREE guest tickets to share the fun with friends and family
- FREE parking and discounts on food, beverage, and merchandise (select tiers)
- FREE Busch Bucks to spend in park
- Be among the first to experience new attractions
- Discounts on one-of-a-kind animal encounters, VIP Tours, and Youth Summer Camps


For more information, visit[Busch Gardens Tampa Bay](https://buschgardens.com/tampa/) and[Busch Gardens Williamsburg](https://buschgardens.com/williamsburg/) .


**About Busch Gardens**
Busch Gardens® is a premier family destination offering world-class coasters, immersive animal habitats, award-winning seasonal festivals, and year-round entertainment. With parks in Williamsburg, Virginia, and Tampa Bay, Florida, Busch Gardens is known for its blend of thrilling rides, enriching animal encounters, and unforgettable live entertainment. Both parks are accredited by the Association of Zoos and Aquariums (AZA) and Humane Certified by American Humane, reflecting the company’s commitment to animal welfare and conservation. Busch Gardens is part of the United Parks & Resorts Inc. (NYSE: PRKS) portfolio of theme park brands. For more information, visit[BuschGardens.com](https://buschgardens.com/) .
